title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce Service Cloud Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 58531Sobre a BRQ Digital Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior. Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.BRQ WAY No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!- O que procuramos? Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!-O que você deve ter? Responsabilidades: Implementar funcionalidades em Apex (triggers, services, batch/queueable/schedulable), garantindo bulkification, testes e respeito aos limites da plataforma. Desenvolver Lightning Web Components (LWC) com arquitetura limpa, performance, consumo de dados via LDS/wire e chamadas @AuraEnabled. Construir e manter integrações (REST/SOAP): callouts com Named Credentials, autenticação (OAuth/JWT), tratamento de erros e observabilidade (logs/monitoramento). Atuar no ecossistema de Service Cloud & Digital Engagement (Chat, WhatsApp, Bots), integrando fluxos de atendimento e automações. Realizar troubleshooting avançado (debug logs, trace flags, Event Monitoring) e otimizações de performance/consultas. Versionar e implantar com SFDX + Git (branching, code review, qualidade de código). Garantir segurança e compliance (FLS/CRUD, compartilhamento, transações) e produzir documentação técnica de suporte às entregas. Requisitos obrigatórios: Forte experiência como Desenvolvedor(a) Salesforce (Pleno/Sênior) com foco em Service Cloud. Domínio de Apex, SOQL/SOSL, padrões assíncronos e testes unitários (qualidade e cobertura). Experiência com LWC (JS moderno, componentização, comunicação com Apex). Vivência com Digital Engagement (Chat/Messaging/WhatsApp), incluindo implementação técnica e integração com processos de atendimento. Integrações via API REST/SOAP em Apex (Named Credentials, serialização JSON/XML, tratamento de exceções). Troubleshooting e análise de logs em ambientes produtivos e sandboxes. Conhecimento aprofundado de governor limits e estratégias de otimização. Prática com Salesforce DX e Git (pull requests, code review). Certificações: Platform Developer I CLT, salário a combinar+ benefícios. 100% remoto.- O que temos pra te oferecer? Mais do que um plano de carreira! A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares: Carreira técnica:Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos! Carreira de Liderança:Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos. Experiência internacional:Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede. Empreendedorismo:De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.- E os benefícios? Plano de Saúde;
Plano Odontológico;
Seguro de Vida;
Vale Refeição;
Vale Alimentação;
Horário Flexível;
Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!-Como é trabalhar na BRQ? Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.Com/brqdigitalsolutionsCurtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Vmware Vcf Consultant
description: ITTConnect is seeking aVMWare Cloud Engineer expert in Cloud Formationto work remotely for a client in the US.The VCF expert will design, deploy, and support modern VMware infrastructure. All interviews will be in English only.Key Responsibilities: Deploy and manage VCF, including management and workload domains. Implement and optimize vSphere, vSAN, NSX‐T, HCX, and SRM. Troubleshoot issues across compute, storage, and network virtualization. Perform capacity planning, health checks, and risk assessments. Produce documentation and operational handoff materials. Support DR architecture and testing. Provide knowledge transfer to customers and internal teams.Requirements 10+ years of IT experience MUST BE fluent in English MUST BE an expert in VMWare Cloud Foundation Experience with VCF or large‐scale VMware deployments. Strong understanding of virtualization, networking, and storage. Hands‐on with at least two: vSAN, NSX‐T, HCX, SRM. Familiarity with HCI platforms (e.G. Dell VxRail). Strong troubleshooting and communication skills. Preferred VMware certifications (VCP/VCAP/VCIX). Experience with automation (PowerCLI, Ansible, Terraform). Exposure to AWS/Azure/GCP and hybrid integrations. Knowledge of backup/storage platforms like PowerStore or Veeam. Previous experience in Consulting and/or client facing roles

title: Engenheiro De Software Sênior
description: Colaborando com a revolução digital!Na Firedev, nossa paixão é impulsionar a transformação digital através de soluções inovadoras e eficientes. Somos uma empresa especializada em tecnologia, focada em oferecer serviços diversos que aceleram o desenvolvimento de software. Utilizando uma abordagem Low Code, capacitamos nosso cliente a criar, personalizar e manter aplicações de maneira ágil e adaptável, respondendo rapidamente às demandas do mercado em constante evolução.Conheça nosso desafio!Aqui na Firedev somos pioneiros em soluções de terceirização, proporcionando equipes com expertise e qualificações excepcionais. Nossos grupos atuam de forma sinérgica e autogerenciada, adotando abordagens ágeis para garantir eficácia e primazia em todos os empreendimentos.Estamos buscandoEngenheiros de Software Sênior hands-onpara apoiar a construção e operacionalização do modelo de uso deInteligência Artificial no ciclo de desenvolvimento de software (SDLC)da empresa. Esses profissionais atuarão próximos à liderança de engenharia, ajudando a transformar estratégia em execução prática, apoiando squads na adoção de ferramentas e práticas de IA que aumentem produtividade, qualidade e escala no desenvolvimento de software. Não buscamos um perfil acadêmico ou focado em pesquisa em IA, mas simengenheiros experientes que saibam aplicar tecnologia na prática dentro do fluxo real de desenvolvimento .Atividades Apoiar a evolução do modelo operacional de uso de IA no ciclo de desenvolvimento de software. Identificar oportunidades de uso de IA nas diferentes etapas do SDLC. Criar playbooks, templates e padrões reutilizáveis para engenharia. Apoiar squads piloto e escalar boas práticas para outras equipes. Colaborar na definição e uso de copilots, prompts, automações e workflows baseados em IA. Mapear gargalos no fluxo de desenvolvimento e propor melhorias práticas. Consolidar aprendizados das iniciativas e transformá-los em padrões operacionais. Apoiar a documentação e o enablement dos times de engenharia.Requisitos e qualificações Experiência sólida em engenharia de software em ambientes corporativos ou de larga escala. Vivência prática com SDLC e processos de desenvolvimento modernos. Experiência com developer productivity, DevEx, platform engineering ou melhoria de processos de engenharia. Capacidade de transformar diretrizes estratégicas em execução prática junto aos times de desenvolvimento. Experiência trabalhando com desenvolvedores, tech leads, arquitetura, QA e segurança. Perfil hands-on, pragmático e colaborativo. Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA aplicadas ao desenvolvimento de software. Experiência com GitHub Copilot ou ferramentas similares. Vivência com Java e PythonDetalhes de contratação: Modelo de contrato: CLT Regime: Remoto Sede da empresa: São Paulo/SPO que oferecemos:Plano de saúde e odontológico: na Firedev, dispomos de assistência médica e odontológica 100% subsidiadas por nós, após o período de experiência, para cuidarmos de você! Tem presente!: no seu aniversário, depositamos crédito no seu cartão de benefícios para você escolher o seu presente! Sem máquina? Sem problemas! title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
WE ARE LOOKING FOR Auditors of Certificates of InsuranceHOW THIS POSITION HELPS JONES SUCCEED As an Auditor of Certificates of Insurance (COI) you will be responsible for verifying that the documents provided by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors in our platform have the necessary coverage required by our customers.All the necessary training to perform the necessary tasks will be offered.KEY RESPONSIBILITIES The high-level goal for this role is to help the company to deliver accurate audit resolutions in a timely manner.This role demands a high level of commitment and dedication;
this is a full-time, hands-on position requiring 40 hours per week, with occasional after-hours work as needed (including additional compensation). This is not a role for someone seeking a casual or part-time opportunity;
it demands undivided attention and cannot be reconciled with concurrent employment commitmentsBe prepared for a fast-paced environment and to seek process improvements and personal development actively.WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT Be detail-oriented. High level of thoroughness, accuracy, organization, and productivity;
Communicate fluently inEnglish (advanced written skills);
Availability to work 40hours per week during American business hoursç Eager to learn and keen on coaching and feedback;
Open to failure and rejection in the spirit of learning, progress, and resilienceç Ability to demonstrate a level of success in executing a repeatable operation methodologyç Must be self-motivated, persistent, and able to work independently.WHAT MAKES THIS JOB A GREAT OPPORTUNITY Build subject-matter expertise in an area of real estate operations and insurance that is lucrative and is undergoing serious digital transformation;
Fair compensation with pay raises and bonuses;
Mentorship from talented leaders;
Be part of an award-winning company that is tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month;
Be part of a lean and agile team, with a strong culture;
Help Jones execute a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world;
Gain a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.OUR CULTURE Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their roles and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward.Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following:We get things done, period, full stop We give help generously We fall in love with customer problems We feel the pain, then we fix the process We build trust everywhere We take care of ourselves with rest, time away from work and simply having funABOUT JONES Jones helps real estate and construction firms to remove the barrier of insurance compliance through one software application that integrates with core operating systems. We envision a world where every property and construction site is connected by a network of insurance data enabling individuals to find, check and verify compliance instantly. Over 1 billion square feet of real estate relies on Jones daily, including firms such as Empire State Realty, Tishman Speyer, JLL, Rudin Management, and many more.We have headquarters in New York, NY, and Tel Aviv, Israel. Our team spans 16 countries. Brazil's crew is expanding fast, fully remote, with annual in-person gatherings.

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description: Manager, Corporate DevelopmentPerseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.Com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.Location:BrazilThe Role: The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.G. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus' acquisition of software companies.The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.Outcomes: Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s). Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs. Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency. Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals. Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.Relevant Experience & Competencies: At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles. A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing. Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered. Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals. Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours. Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.Other Requirements: This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Data Analyst V
description: Título da posição:Data Analyst V BRL Tipo de contratação:Temporário via agência Modelo de trabalho:Home officeVisão Geral da Posição A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. A equipe atua em parceria próxima com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders de negócio para mensurar o desempenho das nossas ofertas aos clientes, gerar insights sobre o comportamento dos clientes e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.O(a) Analista de Dados desempenhará um papel crítico na transformação de dados complexos em insights acionáveis, no desenvolvimento de frameworks analíticos e na viabilização do monitoramento de performance por meio de dashboards, relatórios e análises aprofundadas. Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.O que você fará Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras. Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos. Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança. Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão. Atuar em parceria com as equipes de engenharia de dados, finanças e outros times de analytics para garantir qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade das soluções de reporte. Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior. Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics.Qualificações Mínimas Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada. Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance. Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente). Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI). Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos. Capacidade comprovada de colaboração eficaz em equipes multifuncionais. Inglês fluente.Qualificações Desejáveis Experiência com análises financeiras ou de gestão de performance de negócios. Familiaridade com técnicas analíticas avançadas (previsão, análise estatística, modelagem de cenários). Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS). Experiência com pipelines de dados, automação ou ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow). Experiência com big data ou frameworks de processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark). Experiência em organização global matricial.

title: Executivo Comercial Hunter - Grandes Contas - Mercado Pago | Natal, Rn.
description: No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias. Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico, para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina. Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques. Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.Temos um desafio para as pessoas que: Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites. Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação. Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros. A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas. Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão. Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores,e sendo responsável por:Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com o perfil de Grandes Contas. Atuar de forma consultiva, compreendendo as dores e oportunidades dos clientes para propor soluções completas de valor agregado ao negócio. Gerir todo o funil de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento e onboarding do cliente sendo usuário modelo dos sistemas da companhia. Sustentar relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes e parceiros de negócio e monitorar tendências de mercado, comportamento da concorrência e oportunidades de crescimento para a sua região de atuação. Trabalhar em sinergia com equipes de produtos e operações para garantir a melhor entrega ao cliente. title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:

Strong track record of driving product adoption, value realization, and revenue expansion. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills;
experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required;
Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities. Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team. By Day 90 Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement. Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.Join Client! Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. This role offers more than a position — it's an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity. If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let's build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

title: Devops Engineer
description:
We're looking for a DevOps / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure. This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments. We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.Why this role exists We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing DevOps operations and architecture support. We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well. Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.TL;
DR You will help lead cloud and DevOps initiatives at Quave. Your job is to: Lead cloud migrations to OCI Design cloud architectures Automate migrations and infrastructure Coordinate DevOps engineers Talk directly to clients Help build repeatable DevOps processes You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients. English is a plus, not required.This is not a ticket-based DevOps job If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you. This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:\ "We can automate 80% of this.\" And then actually build the automation.What you'll actually do Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.Cloud Migrations A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI. Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.Automation We want to automate everything that can be automated: Automated infrastructure provisioning Migration scripts CI/CD pipelines Environment replication Monitoring setups If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.Client Discussions You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.Leading DevOps Engineers As the DevOps work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.What we're looking for You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems. You likely: Love automating infrastructure Hate manual processes Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems Are comfortable debugging production environments Enjoy designing architectures Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.Technical Expectations Cloud Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important AWS Azure GCPDevOps Docker Kubernetes Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools CI/CD pipelines Linux systems administration Networking fundamentals Automation Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.Languages Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.Why work with Quave We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software. Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy. Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).Pay and Benefits This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience. Fully remote work Flexible hours 22 days paid time off per year Quarterly bonus based on company performance AI allowance for productivity tools We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.Hiring Process Application review Technical conversation Architecture discussion Conversation(s) with one or more partners This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the DevOps work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

title: P&C Insurance Claims Expert
description:
*Please submit your CV in English only.Location: Remote – based near Sao Paolo, BrazilPOSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:As a P&C Insurance Claims Expert, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our customers. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer's technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP's, support FRISS' implementation teams & other potential duties.DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:Customer Relationship Management Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on expectations and needs.Proactive Engagement Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.Performance Monitoring Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and intervene early when needed.Product Enhancements Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the customer.Renewals and Upselling Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.Customer Training Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.Internal Collaboration Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.JOB SKILLS:Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global environment.Must Haves: Insurance Expertise Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS' product valueLanguage Skills This role requires tri-lingual language skills: Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil;
fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM;
and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.Nice to Haves: Customer Focus and Engagement You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand their needs and exceed their expectations.Business & Analytical Insights You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS' value through storytelling and analytical insights.Technical Proficiency You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

description:

é sobre potencializar resultados.Increase the power of your business .Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:Estamos em busca de um (a) Engenheiro (a) de Software com IA para projetar, desenvolver e evoluir soluções que utilizam Inteligência Artificial e Machine Learning, atuando de ponta a ponta, da concepção técnica até a implementação em produção. Proficiência em linguagens como Python, Java, Go, JavaScript ou TypeScript;
Experiência com frameworks e bibliotecas de IA e Machine Learning (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, LangChain ou Hugging Face);
Conhecimento em APIs, microserviços e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos;
Experiência com cloud computing (Google Cloud ou Azure);
Familiaridade com containers e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);
Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
Experiência com versionamento de código (Git) e práticas de CI/CD. Diferenciais: Experiência prática com LLMs, GenAI, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e fine-tuning de modelos;
Conhecimento em ferramentas de dados como Databricks, BigQuery ou Spark;
Experiência com MLOps (MLflow, Kubeflow ou Vertex AI);
Vivência em ambientes de alta escala ou sistemas críticos;
Conhecimento em segurança aplicada à IA e governança de dados;
Experiência prévia em produtos digitais orientados a dados. O que esperamos de você - Soft Skills: Adaptabilidade;
Colaboração;
Visãode dono;

title: Analista Processos Regulatorios Jr
description:

Com quase 60 anos de história e mais de 60 marcas, atuamos de forma ampla e integrada, com soluções para escolas, governos e estudantes dos 2 aos 100 anos. Contamos com mais de 26 mil colaboradores e o nosso propósito é claro: oferecer soluções educacionais que impulsionam pessoas e organizações a construírem uma melhor versão de si. Quer fazer parte de um time que inova e impacta milhões? Sua jornada começa aqui!Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Processos Regulatórios Jr. para atuar no suporte às rotinas de monitoramento regulatório e organização de informações estratégicas da companhia. A pessoa será responsável por apoiar o controle e atualização de dados, garantindo conformidade e visibilidade dos processos regulatórios para a gestão.Responsabilidades e atribuições

- Apoiar na gestão e manutenção de aplicações em Power Apps utilizadas pela área.
- Atualizar e alimentar painéis e relatórios de indicadores, assegurando a visibilidade dos processos regulatórios.
- Acompanhar e registrar novas portarias, normas e legislações, mantendo as bases de dados atualizadas.
- Dar suporte técnico e operacional ao time, auxiliando na interpretação de informações regulatórias e organização de documentos.
- Contribuir para a organização de dados e informações sensíveis, garantindo precisão, segurança e rastreabilidade.
- Apoiar na preparação de documentações e materiais para auditorias, diligências ou visitas regulatórias.
- Eventualmente, poderá participar de viagens para suporte em atividades da área.Requisitos e qualificações
- Organização e atenção a detalhes no tratamento de dados e informações.
- Conhecimento ou familiaridade com Excel (controles e bases de dados).
- Experiência ou interesse em Power Apps e gestão de indicadores/painéis será considerado um diferencial.
- Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalho colaborativo.Informações adicionais O que você pode esperar da gente? Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna. Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível. Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação. Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.Mas espera, ainda tem mais! Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos). Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar. Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida. Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos. Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente. Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras. Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia. Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê. Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base. Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Desenvolvedor (A) Fullstack Pleno - Neppo
description:

Experiência como Full Stack em produto/SaaS. Conhecimento sólido em backend (Java) e frontend (React/Next.Js ou equivalente). Vivência com APIs REST, integração de serviços externos e eventos em tempo real (WebSocket, pub/sub). Experiência com bancos de dados (SQL/NoSQL), cache e testes (unit/integração/contrato). Noção prática de observabilidade (logs, métricas, tracing) e resiliência (retries, idempotência). Conforto para ler/escrever scripts e manipular uma DSL de automação.NaNeppo, você irá trabalhar com um dos produtos que mais tem ajudado as empresas em seu posicionamento e estratégia de comunicação e relacionamento digital, com oportunidade deascensão profissionalepremiações exclusivasO que a Neppo te oferece: Remuneração fixa;

title: Senior Content Manager
description: As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media's growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.This role contributes directly to the CORE department's objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.To be more specific, you will:Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.The ideal profileWe're looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.You are someone who:Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must) Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus) Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing itYou bring strong CM fundamentals:High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills Ownership mindset over site and content performance Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals Experience working with CMS platformsYou work well with others and think ahead:Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potentialFeeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.Next steps in the process 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role's requirements 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!What's in it for youA full time remote work environment. A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results, not hours. Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path. Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun. We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!MoveUp MediaWe're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of iGaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords.With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!Our approachWe focus on people. We put end users' experience as a priority on all strategies and processes. Thus, we aim to make complex topics easy to understand and provide exactly what our audience is seeking. We achieve this by carefully analyzing data and reflecting upon it, writing the content with care, and ensuring a smooth user experience.Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future! title: Brand & Copy Strategist
description: Hey, Dingus!Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a Brand & Copy Strategist!About UsDingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an "unlimited get-shit-done" subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.Purpose of This PositionAs a Brand & Copy Strategist, you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand's voice, positioning, and intent. You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You bring together copywriting, brand awareness, practical content direction, strategy, and project management to ensure brands are represented clearly and consistently through words.You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.Core ResponsibilityServe as the owner of brand representation through copy for your squad's clients. Your accountability is defined by the following questions: "Is this copy clear, on-brand, purposeful, and strong enough to confidently move forward?"\ "Is this project timeline possible with the resources we have for proper execution?"Main Objectives1. Content Execution & Copywriting Write high-quality, purpose-driven copy for: -Websites -Social media captions and post copy -Email campaigns -Campaign and promotional assets Design-related copy (headlines, CTAs, supporting text) Act as the primary writer for all copy deliverables within your squad. Ensure every piece of copy is written with intention, clarity, and audience awareness. Perform copyediting on your own work to maintain consistency, grammatical excellence, and brand alignment, using tools and peers as needed.2. Strategy & Project Management Create social media strategies for your clients based on their goals and audiences Keep track of client feedback and apply them to future work Plan content in batches for the month, ensuring: -Consistency in writing style -Variety in content types -A range of related, engaging topics3. Social Media Copy & Content Direction Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand's voice and messaging. When appropriate, define content themes and messaging direction for social platforms. When deeper strategy or clarity is required, collaborate with Special Teams to receive social content strategy support or plans. Execute all social media copy in alignment with the strategy you create and flag any gaps or unclear direction early.4. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency Participate in brainstorming and ideation sessions to help define the content, messaging, and assets required for campaigns and initiatives. Provide copy-led input on creative direction to ensure consistency of brand voice, messaging, and intent across all touchpoints. Collaborate with designers, Marketing Coordinators, and Account Managers to align written and visual assets under a cohesive brand narrative. Contribute perspective beyond copy when needed to maintain brand clarity and consistency.5. Brand Advocacy Act as the copy owner for each assigned brand, ensuring consistent voice, tone, and messaging across all written content. Apply brand guidelines and positioning directly within copy execution. Review copy deliverables to ensure they meet internal quality standards and accurately represent the brand's intent.Reporting Relationship This role reports to the designated Account Manager of your squad.Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)1. Brand Alignment & Copy Effectiveness Ensure all copy deliverables are consistently aligned with the brand's voice, tone, and messaging. Maintain minimal client revisions related to brand alignment, tone, or clarity. Contribute social content ideas and messaging angles when needed, ensuring alignment with the brand's voice, positioning, and goals. Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure brand consistency across copy and supporting assets.2. Content Quality & Accuracy Deliver copy that meets internal quality standards for clarity, structure, and purpose. Maintain a low rate of client dissatisfaction related to copy quality or intent.3. Project Delivery Timeliness Deliver copy-related tasks within agreed timelines. Collaborate with the squad to support smooth handoffs and on-time delivery of content assets.Work Details Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday Requires a working level of written and spoken EnglishReady for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description: Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.ComThe Role The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group.In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations.As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini's M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini's deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization.Key Outcomes Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals. Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs. Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini's M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities. Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals. Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams. Support the long-term build-out of Gemini's LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development. Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal. Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation. Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit. Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time.Relevant Experience & Competencies At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector. Experience in outbound deal origination planning. Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities. Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development. Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments. Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously. Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency.Other Requirements Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal. Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required. Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

title: Clinical Trial Associate Ii
description:
Clinical Trial Associate IIResumo da Posição O Clinical Trial Associate II desempenha um papel fundamental de suporte no planejamento, execução e encerramento de estudos clínicos nacionais e internacionais, com crescente autonomia e independência operacional. Com base em experiências prévias em operações de estudos clínicos, espera-se que o CTA II gerencie proativamente a documentação e os processos principais, identifique e resolva desafios operacionais, e atue como um ponto de coordenação confiável entre as equipes de estudo, fornecedores e centros de pesquisa. Este cargo também contribui para melhorias de processos e apoia a equipe na preparação para auditorias e inspeções.Principais Responsabilidades: - Fornecer suporte operacional para a execução bem-sucedida dos estudos clínicos, do desenvolvimento do protocolo até o encerramento do estudo, em conformidade com as Boas Práticas Clínicas (GCP) e normas regulatórias internacionais. - Gerenciar de forma independente os controles dos estudos clínicos, incluindo acompanhamento de documentos regulatórios, progresso de start-up, métricas de recrutamento, registros de faturas/pagamentos e desempenho de fornecedores, assegurando precisão, consistência e atualizações em tempo hábil. - Coordenar reuniões de estudos clínicos (internas e externas), incluindo preparação de agendas, logística dos encontros e atas detalhadas com ações de acompanhamento. - Apoiar a supervisão de fornecedores e CROs, acompanhando entregas, identificando lacunas ou riscos e comunicando-os preventivamente aos Clinical Trial Managers (CTMs). - Auxiliar na preparação e submissão de documentos para Comitês de Ética/Comissões de Ética (IRB/EC) e para órgãos regulatórios, com papel ampliado na gestão de prazos e controle de qualidade. - Realizar revisões contínuas do Trial Master File (TMF) e reconciliações;
liderar atividades de controle de qualidade de documentos com supervisão mínima e contribuir ativamente para o planejamento de prontidão para inspeções. - Coordenar e acompanhar a logística de equipamentos e suprimentos dos estudos clínicos junto a fornecedores e centros. - Colaborar com CTMs e demais áreas para promover melhorias contínuas de processos e contribuir para atualizações de Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (SOP) e instruções de trabalho. - Assumir responsabilidade por projetos especiais e iniciativas transversais que exijam iniciativa, pensamento analítico e discernimento para resolver problemas.Qualificações - Graduação preferencialmente nas áreas de Ciências Biológicas ou Saúde. - Inglês Fluente - Conhecimento prático demonstrado das diretrizes ICH-GCP e normas regulatórias aplicáveis;
experiência prévia no suporte a TMF, CTMS e atividades de controle de qualidade documental é obrigatória. - Fortes habilidades interpessoais e de comunicação escrita;
confortável em interagir com áreas como Garantia da Qualidade, Gerenciamento de Dados, Bioestatística, Segurança e Suprimentos Clínicos. - Capacidade de antecipar as necessidades da equipe, tomar iniciativa e propor soluções em um ambiente dinâmico. - Confortável em lidar com dados sensíveis, exercendo discrição adequada.Contratação no regime PJ, posição remota com disponibilidade para viagens internacionais conforme necessidade.

title: Corporate Travel Agent

Spanish is a plus. - Tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and flexible for night/weekend shifts. Exceptional verbal and written communication skills across multiple languages. We foster a culture that embodies entrepreneurship, hands-on collaboration, and teamwork. Our flexible work environment supports work-life balance, eliminating commuting time and offering opportunities for relocation or nomadic work. We are driven by a global mindset, a passion for client success, and a strong focus on results. Our environment values risk-taking, leadership development, and learning by doing, providing multiple opportunities for personal and professional growth. We respect diversity at all levels and embrace meritocracy, rewarding high performance and ensuring no space for toxic behavior or poor performance. bTd is committed to corporate governance, ethics, and mutual trust, building confidence through facts and evidence rather than perceptions. We promote an open, friendly, and respectful atmosphere where differences and preferences are honored. Join us and grow alongside bTd, with the opportunity to become part of the company's evolution and stakes.Terms of Employment: Employment underCLT (Brazilian Labor Laws). Remote work arrangement, with a 44-hour workweek Flexibility to travel domestically within Brazil and internationally to locations where bTd operates. This position is required or night shift and weekends, with flexibility. Excels in remote work for a global hybrid startup, combining tech-driven travel solutions with personalized services.Compensation: Competitive base salary. Night shift extra hours Performance-based bonuses and monthly premiums based on achieving KPIs. Sales commissions for achieving and exceeding targets. Health and dental insurance. Food card. Birthday day off. Opportunity for professional growth, with the potential to be promoted toHead of Corporate Globallyas bTd evolves through its funding rounds. Access to travel-related perks and benefits as part of the bTd team.Important Note Before Applying: Let's keep it real! Apply only if you meet at least 8 0% of the qualificationsand can prove it with yourLinkedIn profileorupdated resume. We're not looking for someone who just\ "gets it\" — we need aself-starterready to deliver results fromday one. Forget gaming LinkedIn algorithms;
we care about real achievements. If your experience matches the role and your profile shows your impact, we're excited to hear from you, hire you fast, reward your contributions, and grow together. title: Software Engineer
description:
Role Overview We are looking for a hands‐on Software Engineer to join the Developer Risk (DevRisk) team. You will build data-driven features and services that power developer review and enforcement workflows. The role spans querying large datasets, building back-end services and front-end review UI components, and implementing platform capabilities that improve risk detection and decision-making. You will collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, and reviewers to translate business criteria into robust tooling and dashboards, ensuring accuracy, performance, and end‐to‐end reliability.Key Responsibilities Data Querying & Reporting: Write efficient SQL queries to extract data from the DevRisk Data Warehouse and populate dashboards/spreadsheets to deliver required statistics and insights. Policy & Criteria Improvements: Identify improvements to developer ban criteria based on data analysis and implement corresponding changes in DevRisk tooling and review UI. Frontend (Review UI): Build pages and widgets in the reviewer UI to render critical information for decision-making;
ensure usability, consistency, and performance. Backend Services: Design and implement back-end services and APIs to power the review UI and related enforcement workflows. Enforcement Platform: Design and implement platform functionality that enables accurate, auditable, and scalable developer enforcement. Quality & Reliability: Perform end‐to‐end testing, optimization, and integration of implemented services;
monitor performance anditerate based on feedback. Documentation: Document data lineage, UI/UX behavior, and service contracts to support operability and governance.Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Industry experience in software engineering or closely related areas. Proficiency in at least one of C++, Java, or Python. Strong experience with SQL for complex querying and data manipulation. Fluency in English (reading, writing, speaking, and listening).Preferred Qualifications Proficiency in Java/C++/Python and SQL (multiple languages). Experience with ETL and data pipelines (batch and/or streaming). Hands‐on experience with version control, collaborative code reviews, and automated testing (e.G., Git/Gerrit, CI/CD, unit/integration/e2e testing). Exposure to risk, trust & safety, enforcement systems, or policy tooling is a plus. Familiarity with data modeling, observability (metrics, logging, tracing), and secure coding practices.Tech Stack (Indicative) Languages: Java, Python, C++ Data: SQL, Data Warehouse, ETL/ELT tools, spreadsheets/dashboarding Backend: REST/gRPC services, microservices, authentication/authorization Frontend: Component‐based UI (widgets/pages for reviewer workflows) Testing: Unit, integration, E2E;
CI/CD pipelines Ops: Monitoring, alerting, performance tuningWhat We're Looking For Strong problem‐solving skills and a data‐driven mindset. Ability to translate policy/business requirements into technical designs. Ownership across the lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support. Excellent collaboration with cross‐functional partners and stakeholders.Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Analista De Relações Com Investidores E Esg Iii

title: Sap Basis Engineer

Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.Nosso Cliente Você atuará em um projeto global de grande porte no segmento de energia, com ambiente SAP robusto e crítico, composto por aproximadamente 15 sistemas produtivos ECC e S/4HANAO que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho Administração e configuração de ambientes SAP (Basis) Suporte e sustentação de sistemas SAP (performance, interfaces e disponibilidade) Troubleshooting e resolução de incidentes críticos Monitoramento técnico e tuning de performance Execução de rotinas de manutenção (RFCs, profiles, housekeeping, etc.) Planejamento e execução de upgrades e melhorias Gestão de backup & recovery Atuação com replicação de dados (SLT) Execução de testes de Disaster Recovery e Cyber Recovery Participação em modelo Follow The Sun (FTS) para suporte global Atuação em ambientes ágeis (squads, sprints, backlog - ADO) Participação em escala de plantão (on-call rotativo)O que você precisa ter Experiência sólida em SAP Basis Vivência comSAP S/4HANA e SAP HANA Database Experiência comSAP NetWeaver(ABAP e Java) Conhecimento em ferramentas comoSolution Manager, Focused Run ou SAP LaMa Experiência com troubleshooting, tuning e monitoramento de sistemas SAP Conhecimento em backup & recovery Experiência com replicação de dados (SLT) Conhecimento em sistemas operacionais e suporte a banco de dados Experiência com scripts(PowerShell ou Shell) Vivência com gestão de incidentes, problemas e mudanças Inglês avançado (atuação global)Será um destaque seu perfil com: Conhecimento em HANA Pacemaker Experiência com ambientes de alta disponibilidade Vivência em projetos globais e ambientes complexos Perfil proativo e colaborativo Facilidade para atuar em times ágeisOnde você vai trabalhar? No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

Esperamos que você encabece integrações complexas, atue no tuning avançado das aplicações e suas integrações com bancos de dados (SQL/NoSQL) e seja protagonista na adoção de tecnologias emergentes, além de criar ambientes de confiança para revisões de código de alto padrão.Como será seu dia-a-dia? Implementar e evoluir arquiteturas de aplicações de microsserviços e sistemas orientados a eventos, garantindo escalabilidade, resiliência e manutenibilidade ao longo do tempo;
Elaborar templates de arquitetura de aplicação de referência para o time, sempre que demandado;
Protagonizar decisões técnicas com visão de impacto, explicitando trade-offs para o time e para produto, mesmo em cenários com informações incompletas;
Garantir a estabilidadedos sistemas em produção, realizando a resposta a incidentes, definindo prioridades de correção e propondo melhorias estruturais para evitar recorrência;
Implementar e disseminar práticas de observabilidade (OpenTelemetry, APM com Datadog/NewRelic/Dynatrace) e tracing distribuído para aumentar a previsibilidade operacional;
Conduzir code reviews de alto padrão, orientando o time em boas práticas de arquitetura, design patterns, testes e segurança;
Atuar em integrações complexas com sistemas internos e externos, aplicando padrões de resiliência como Circuit Breaker, Retry, Fallback e SAGA;
Identificar gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria em queries SQL, estratégias de cache e configurações de pool de conexões para otimizar a performance das aplicações;
Apoiar diretamente líderes técnicos (Tech Leads) em acordos técnicos entre squad, produto e demais áreas, traduzindo complexidade técnica em impacto de negócio de forma clara e rastreável;
Explorar e adotar tecnologias emergentes de forma responsável, avaliando custo, benefício e risco antes da incorporação no stack do time. Aprimorar continuamente os processos e práticas de desenvolvimento, aplicando técnicas de uso de Inteligência Artificial para otimizar o desenvolvimento de software, de forma avançada e responsável.Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:Profundidade em Java avançado: Multithread, gerenciamento de memória/GC, Virtual Threads (Java 21) e domínio das diferenças entre versões LTS, bem como domínio total de programação funcional;
Domínio amplo de DesignPatterns com capacidade de reconhecer o momento certo de aplicá-los;
entendimento de como a Injeção de Dependência funciona internamente (Reflection/Proxies);
Experiência sólida com Spring (Boot, Data, Security) e uso de frameworks reativos;
Domínio de estratégias de resiliência em integrações: Circuit Breaker, Retry, Fallback e SAGA (ex: Resilience4j);
domínio do conceito de Idempotência;
Experiência prática e profunda com Kafka (Partições, Offsets, Consumer Groups) e RabbitMQ avançado (DLQ, Retry Policies, Exchanges);
Capacidade de realizar tuning de queries SQL, criação de índices, e estratégias de cache (local vs distribuído, TTL e invalidação);
Domínio avançado de pelo menos um banco de dados relacional e um banco NoSQL (MongoDB ou DynamoDB);
Domínio de observabilidade avançada com OpenTelemetry, pelo menos uma ferramenta de APM (Datadog/NewRelic/Dynatrace) e tracing distribuído;
Experiência prática comKubernetes. Não irá administrar diretamente, mas é necessária experiência de interpretação do ecossistema;
Experiência prática comcomponentes de pelo menos uma Cloud (AWS ou GCP) Capacidade real e experiência em Documentação como código usando Mermaid ou PlantUML através de arquivos markdown;
Domínio sólido de estratégias em pelo menos uma ferramenta de IA assistida (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Antigravity ou Claude Code), bem como experiência prática de consumo de pelo menos 1 tipo de MCP Server através destas ferramentas.Você irá se destacar se:Ser committer ativo em repositórios open-source relevantes;

Experiência com frameworks como Apache Camel ou outros de integração de sistemas (ESB/EDA);

Experiência em integração arquitetural de APIs de LLM (LangChain, RAG/bancos vetoriais) ou criação de soluções próprias baseadas em IA;
Capacidade de liderar migrações de monolitos para microsserviços;
Ter implementado mais de dois exemplos de servidores MCP de alta complexidade técnica.O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
This is mostly manual position. This role is fully remote and is a PJ contractor.Required Skills & Experience - 7+ years of experience in Quality Assurance (manual and/or blended QA roles) with strong ownership of test execution and release readiness. - Jira proficiency for defect tracking, workflows, and reporting. - Hands-on experience with API testing (e.G., Postman, Swagger, curl, or similar) — note: API work is a smaller portion (~10%). - Cruise / travel / hotel / hospitality industry experience - Strong understanding of QA fundamentals: test design, defect lifecycle, SDLC/STLC, and Agile testing practices. Excellent communication skills and ability to partner cross-functionally.Nice to Have Skills & Experience - Experience testing eCommerce, booking engines, reservations, loyalty, payments, check-in/boarding, or guest service platforms. - Exposure to test automation (any framework/tool) and ability to collaborate with automation engineers (if applicable). - Basic SQL for validation, data checks, or troubleshooting. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and release processes.Job DescriptionWe are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of customer-facing and internal applications in a fast-paced travel/hospitality environment. This role will partner closely with product, engineering, and delivery teams to define test strategy, execute testing across releases, and continuously improve QA processes. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on QA experience, deep familiarity with Jira, and working knowledge of API testing (a smaller portion of the overall workload).Day to Day - Own and execute end-to-end testing for web and/or mobile applications, including functional, regression, smoke, and UAT support. - Create and maintain clear test plans, test cases, and test execution evidence aligned to release timelines. - Work in Agile/Scrum teams to provide early QA input on requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge cases. - Log, track, and manage defects in Jira, ensuring high-quality documentation and strong follow-through through resolution. - Perform API validation/testing (estimated ~10% of overall effort) using tools such as Postman/Swagger or similar;
validate request/response payloads and integration behaviors. - Collaborate with engineers and product owners to reproduce issues, validate fixes, and confirm release readiness. - Help improve QA efficiency through better test coverage, risk-based testing, and repeatable regression approaches. Contribute to quality standards, best practices, and continuous improvement across the SDLC.

title: English Teacher With Advanced Portuguese Skills
description: Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Tech Lead Salesforce Developer
description:
Tech Lead Salesforce DeveloperImportant Information Location:Brazil Job Mode:Full-time Work Mode:Work from homeJob SummaryWe are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data;
partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don't meet requirements;
Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
Document processes, standards, and runbooks;
contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.Essential SkillsExperience with Salesforce development;
Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.G., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership.Highly Desirable SkillsExperience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).About EncoraEncora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world's leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora's technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.
